name: DeepSeek-V3.2
notes: Same MLA skeleton as V3 (61 layers, hidden 7168, 256 routed + 1 shared, 8 per token, kv_lora_rank 512) so KV is unchanged: 61 x 576 x 2 = 70,272 B/token. The architectural change is the sparse attention indexer: config adds index_topk 2048 with index_n_heads/index_head_dim present in V4 and absent in V3.2, i.e. a lightweight top-k selector attends over a candidate set instead of the full context. That is a decode-time compute saver, not a KV cache saver - the latents are still cached per token. safetensors total 685.36B vs V3's 684.53B. MIT. Note the -Exp and -Speciale checkpoints share this architecture.
